DigitalWaiverFormBuilderInput.description: The request body of `setDigitalWaiverForm`, the layout record itself; read-only properties are ignored.

DigitalWaiverFormBuilderView.description: The layout of one waiver version (pack 11.1.3), keyed on `formId` + `formVersion`. Immutable once the version is published, like the version itself.

mandatoryReading.description: The signatory must tick "I have read and understood this section" before continuing.

showWhen.description: Shown only when the condition holds, e.g. `isMinor` equals `true` shows the guardian section.

subject.description: A field key of this version, or `isMinor` (resolved from the waiver's guardian threshold).

fieldKey.description: The `FormField.key` an input block collects; required for input kinds.

mandatoryNotice.description: Rendered as a notice that cannot be collapsed.

DynamicFieldsQuestionsConditionalLogicVi.description: One field of a waiver version (pack 11.1.4). `fieldType` is the builder's type; the stored `FormField.type` follows from it (shortText text, longText and address longText, yesNo and checkbox boolean, singleSelect and dropdown select, multiSelect multiSelect, mobile phone, the lookups text holding the record id, signature and initials signature).

standardField.description: Set when the field is one of the reusable standard fields.

options.description: The allowed values of a select, dropdown or multi-select field.

pattern.description: The required format, as a regular expression.

conditions.description: All must hold (AND). For `conditional` fields they decide whether the field is shown and required.

mapsTo.description: The existing TICVAI record the field reads from, where the caller may read it.

deleted.description: True removes the field from the draft version.

FormDefinition.description:
CF-129, CL-04. **A waiver, a survey and a data-capture form are one mechanism.**
A waiver is this form with a signature. A survey is this form with a scale. A demographic capture is this form at the point of sale. They were raised as three separate gaps and share every part: field configuration, conditional display, versioning, an acceptance record and a stored artefact.
**Three implementations would drift on the version rule first.** A waiver signed against version 3 must stay bound to version 3, and that is the same requirement a survey has when question wording changes mid-campaign — **an NPS score means nothing if you cannot say which question produced it.**

consentPurposes.description: **What a `consentForm` consents to** (Chinmay, 2 October, batch 4; follows BO-188: biometric capture needs consent on the venue's own form; CHG-CSA-026). A guardian-signed form for a minor carries the guardian fields of the waiver builder (workbook Q237: guardian consent, configurable per country). Empty for any other kind.

version.description: **Set by the server** — 1 on `createForm`, the next number on every change. **Immutable once anything is submitted against it.** A change creates a new version, and the old one stays readable forever — 2.15.13 requires the exact accepted version retained, which is legal evidence rather than a nicety.

requiresSignature.description: **What makes it a waiver.** And 2.15.9 makes ticket issuance conditional on one, which puts this in the purchase path rather than beside it.

scoreScale.description: **What makes it a survey.** Named rather than free-form because a score whose scale is unknown cannot be compared to last quarter's.

validForMonths.description: **How long an acceptance lasts.** A waiver signed last summer may or may not still hold, and 2.15.x asks for a returning participant not to sign again — which only works if the expiry is stated.

requiresGuardianForMinors.description: **A minor cannot waive their own rights.** A guardian signs, and the record has to name them — an unsigned or self-signed minor waiver is worth nothing at the moment it matters.

scopePath.description:
**The partition key** (ADR-0005). Added 31 August: the operations that write this table declare a scope and the table carried no column for it — **49 tables were in that state**, so a row could be written at venue scope and then read by anything that could reach the table.

**`scope_path` rather than a specific id** because it is prefix-comparable: `uae.dubai` contains `uae.dubai.marina`, and one index answers every level of the walk.

**Operations write it at `venue` scope.**

FormField.description: One field. **Conditional display is the shared requirement** — a survey branching on an answer and a waiver revealing a medical question on a yes are the same mechanism.

isPersonalData.description: **Marked at the field, because retention is decided at the field.** A survey answer and a medical condition on the same form have different lifetimes, and a form-level flag makes the whole thing as sensitive as its most sensitive field.

LocalizationBrandingCustomerExperienceCo.description: The request body of `setLocalizationBrandingCustomer`, the record itself; read-only properties are ignored.
Languages, branding and channels of one waiver version (pack 11.1.9), keyed on `formId` + `formVersion`.

sourceLanguage.description: The language the legal text is written and reviewed in.

languages.description: Every language the version is offered in, the source language included. Arabic renders right to left.

required.description: Publication waits for this language's approval.

themeId.description: The white-label theme it takes colours and typography from.

channels.description: Where the waiver is offered; every channel renders the same version and rules.

ProductEventExperienceAssociationView.description: One waiver attached to one target (pack 11.1.6). The waiver's in-force version applies; the version a guest signed is on their signature.

targetId.description: The catalogue, event, venue or brand id; null only for `global`.

conditionRuleId.description: The eligibility rule (`setWaiverTriggerRule`) that makes a conditional association apply.

sequence.description: The order the target's waivers are presented in.

overridesAssociationId.description: The inherited association this one replaces for this target.

impact.description: What depends on this association now (pack Dependency Impact).

SignatorySignatureGuardianRuleConfigurat.description: The request body of `setSignatorySignatureGuardian`, the rule record itself; read-only properties are ignored.
The signatory rules of one waiver version (pack 11.1.5), keyed on `formId` + `formVersion`; immutable once the version is published.

allowedSignatories.description: Who else may sign in the primary signatory's place.

coSignature.description: Set when two people must both sign.

captureRelationship.description: Whoever signs for someone else states their relationship.

guardianThresholdAge.description: A participant under this age needs a guardian. Written to `FormDefinition.minimumAge`. No default.

guardianSignsForEachMinor.description: One guardian signature per minor, never one for the family.

groupSigningModes.description: The modes a group booking may use. Empty means each participant signs individually.

recordedEvidence.description: Always all of them; listed so the reviewer sees what is kept.

legalApprovedBy.description: `FormDefinition.legalReviewedBy`, set at the legal/compliance step of `approveWaiverTesting`.

VersioningEffectiveDatesLegalChangeContr.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.form_definition, marketing.waiver_version_control (new), marketing.form_submission and marketing.waiver_signature
VersioningEffectiveDatesLegalChangeContr.description: One version of one waiver and its change control (pack 11.1.8).

resignRule.description: Whether people who signed an earlier version must sign this one.

signatureCount.description: Signatures taken against this exact version.

changedQuestions.description: Field keys added, removed or changed.

changedSignatoryRules.description: Names of the signatory-rule properties that differ.

changedAssociations.description: Associations added, removed or changed between the two versions' publication.

WaiverApprovalTestingPublicationWorkspac.description: One governance action on a waiver version (pack 11.1.10).

resignRule.description: Required for `submitForReview` of a version after the first.

WaiverApprovalTestingPublicationWorkspac.description: The governance record of one waiver version with its checklist (pack 11.1.10), keyed on `formId` + `formVersion`.

simulation.description: Present when scenario parameters were given.

blockedAt.description: What a missing signature would block, when `missingSignature` was set.

audit.description: Who moved it through each stage, and when (pack Audit).

history.description: Every action with its comment, oldest first.

WaiverConsentCommandCenterView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.form_definition (kind waiver), marketing.waiver_master (new), marketing.waiver_version_control (new) and marketing.waiver_association (new)
WaiverConsentCommandCenterView.description: One row of the waiver directory (pack 11.1.1), a waiver at its latest version. `status` is the pack's lifecycle, derived from `FormDefinition.status` and the version-control record (draft, review, pendingApproval, approved and scheduled are a `draft` form version at that approval stage; suspended is a published version under an emergency suspension; expired is a version past `effectiveTo`; archived is `retired`).

version.description: The latest version, whatever its state.

publishedVersion.description: The version guests currently sign, when that is not the latest.

language.description: The default language from the master record.

languages.description: Every language the version is published in.

associatedProducts.description: Products with an active association (the pack's usage indicator).

WaiverTemplateLibraryMasterSetupView.description: The master record of one waiver (pack 11.1.2), one per `FormDefinition` of kind `waiver`. The name, wording, fields and versions live on the form; this holds classification, ownership and business scope.

customTypeLabel.description: The tenant's own classification name; required when `waiverType` is `customForm`.

brandId.description: Null for a corporate waiver every brand may use.

legalEntityId.description: The finance legal entity the waiver is given in favour of.

applicableCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Empty means the waiver is not yet scoped, which blocks publication.

applicableJurisdiction.description: A sub-national jurisdiction where the law differs within a country.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the latest version (see `listWaiverConsent`).

sourceWaiverId.description: The waiver it was duplicated or created from; required unless `createNew`.

isMasterTemplate.description: Offered in the reusable library. A corporate template is a master template with no `brandId`.

legalReviewRequired.description: Whether the approval chain includes the legal/compliance step. On unless the tenant turns it off.

usage.description: Where the waiver is used now (pack Usage Indicator, Template Dependency).

WaiverTriggerEligibilityCompletionRulesV.description: One trigger, eligibility and completion rule of a waiver (pack 11.1.7).

eligibility.description: All must hold (AND). Empty means every participant the association reaches.

enforcement.description: What an incomplete waiver blocks. Empty means warn only.

allowStaffOverride.description: An authorised operator may admit the participant anyway; the override is recorded.
